author: NASASpaceflight
description:
In this week's episode of This Week in Spaceflight, SpaceX's Starship Flight 13 aborts moments after engine ignition when four Raptors on Booster 20 fail to light, leading to a rollback while the team targets a new launch attempt as soon as Monday.

Japan's JAXA finally flies its Starhopper-style RV-X reusable test vehicle on a successful 40-second hop, Rocket Lab completes a full-duration vacuum Archimedes engine burn with striking blue methane flames for Neutron, and ISRO advances India's Gaganyaan crewed mission with key qualification tests on parachutes, uprighting systems, and separation hardware.

We also cover Firefly's Blue Ghost lunar lander assembly for its second mission, Relativity Space's Terran R progress, PLD Space Miura 5 tank tests, NASA's Dragonfly and DAVINCI updates, Blue Origin's Blue Ring developments, the Soyuz MS-29 crew arrival at the ISS, multiple Starlink launches, and more.
